class WangBrush:
    """Dynamic virtual brush of Wang, Chen, Deng, Hutchinson, Dellaert (IROS 2020, arXiv 1911.08002, Sec. IV-B), re-implemented from
    the paper. State (x, y, z, w, d, o, θ) + the mark's root. One update per 100 Hz physics step from the tip (= the end effector X;
    the brush is held vertically, so π(X) is the tip's xy) and the press depth z (m, > 0 below the paper):
        w <- K_w w + (1 - K_w) Width(z)          d <- K_d d + (1 - K_d) Drag(z)                           (eqs. 6, 7)
        o <- min(Offset(z), |π(X) - root|)        the hairs stay put on the paper until the handle is Offset(z) away   (eq. 8)
        θ <- direction from the root to π(X)      root <- π(X) - o V(θ)                                     (eqs. 1, 9)
    Width/Drag/Offset(z) = the Fig. 4 fits (BRUSH_WANG), 0 when the tip is not below the paper (the hairs straighten: o = 0, the
    root snaps to the handle). Gaps filled here (documented in DESIGN): eq. 9 as printed (V^-1(root - π(X))) has the opposite sign of
    eq. 1; we follow eq. 1 and Fig. 3 (the flat end faces the handle, the drag tail points away from it). θ keeps its value while
    |π(X) - root| <= theta_eps: 0.1 mm in the air, where the root follows the handle, so θ becomes the direction of travel, which
    gives the paper's "θ initialised to the initial trajectory direction" at the next touch-down; 1 mm in contact, because eq. 9 is
    ill-conditioned while the root is under the handle: pressing straight down on a real (jittering) robot made θ spin and the drag
    tail sweep a disc at every touch-down (measured, DESIGN §17). A di

+def target_path(points):
+    """Smooth path through pixel waypoints, sampled by approximately equal arc length."""
+    p = np.asarray(points, dtype=np.float64)
+    ds = np.linalg.norm(np.diff(p, axis=0), axis=1)
+    u = np.r_[0.0, np.cumsum(ds)]
+    # Mild smoothing by cubic interpolation; waypoints were read from the medial axes.
+    tck, _ = splprep([p[:,0], p[:,1]], u=u, s=0.0, k=min(3, len(p)-1))
+    fine_u = np.linspace(0, u[-1], max(2000, int(u[-1]*8)))
+    fx, fy = splev(fine_u, tck)
+    fine = np.column_stack([fx, fy])
+    arclen = np.r_[0.0, np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(fine,axis=0),axis=1))]
+    # About 1.4 pixels per control target (0.31 mm); physics interpolation is finer.
+    sample_s = np.arange(0.0, arclen[-1], 1.4)
+    if sample_s[-1] < arclen[-1]: sample_s = np.r_[sample_s, arclen[-1]]
+    x = np.interp(sample_s, arclen, fine[:,0]); y = np.interp(sample_s, arclen, fine[:,1])
+    pts = np.column_stack([x,y])
+    tang = np.gradient(pts, axis=0)
+    tang /= np.maximum(1e-9, np.linalg.norm(tang,axis=1))[:,None]
+    return pts, sample_s * PX_M * 1000.0, tang
+
+def measured_width_px(pts, tang):
+    """Measure target cross sections around each traced centerline sample."""
+    widths=[]
+    rr = np.arange(-70.0, 70.01, .5)
+    H,W=INK_MASK.shape
+    for (x,y),(tx,ty) in zip(pts,tang):
+        nx,ny=-ty,tx
+        xs=np.clip(np.rint(x+rr*nx).astype(int),0,W-1)
+        ys=np.clip(np.rint(y+rr*ny).astype(int),0,H-1)
+        hit=INK_MASK[ys,xs].astype(bool)
+        # Use the nearest black sample near the center if the fitted spline is off by a pixel.
+        mid=len(rr)//2
+        if not hit[mid]:
+            cand=np.flatnonzero(hit & (np.abs(rr)<=5.0))
+            if len(cand): mid=int(cand[np.argmin(np.abs(rr[cand]))])
+        if not hit[mid]:
+            widths.append(5.0); continue
+        a=mid
+        while a>0 and hit[a-1]: a-=1
+        b=mid
+        while b+1<len(hit) and hit[b+1]: b+=1
+        widths.append(max(1.0, rr[b]-rr[a]+1.0))
+    # Intersecting strokes create a short spur in this profile. Remove those local maxima.
+    w=np.asarray(widths,float)
+    w=median_filter(w,size=61,mode='nearest')
+    w=gaussian_filter1d(w, sigma=7, mode='nearest')
+    return np.clip(w,2.0,57.0)
+
+def press_for_width_mm(width_mm):
+    # Wang model: width(cm) = -0.030 + 1.187 * press(cm).
+    return np.clip((width_mm + 0.30) / 1.187, 0.7, 13.0)
+
+def offset_mm(press_mm):
+    z_cm=np.asarray(press_mm)/10.0
+    return np.maximum(0.0, (-.967*z_cm*z_cm + 2.109994*z_cm - .036001727)*10.0)
+
+def drag_mm(press_mm):
+    return 1.38 + 1.075*np.asarray(press_mm)
+
+def px_to_world(points):
+    # Pixel centers, matching Sheet.px_to_world and the task's stated frame.
+    u=points[:,0]; v=points[:,1]
+    return np.column_stack([
+        -0.100 + 0.11359 - (v + 0.5)*PX_M,

+    for dy in range(-limit,limit+1):
+      y0=max(0,dy); y1=min(1024,1024+dy)
+      py0=max(0,-dy); py1=min(1024,1024-dy)
+      for dx in range(-limit,limit+1):
+        x0=max(0,dx); x1=min(1024,1024+dx)
+        px0=max(0,-dx); px1=min(1024,1024-dx)
+        a=tar[y0:y1,x0:x1]; b=pr[py0:py1,px0:px1]
+        inter=np.logical_and(a,b).sum(); union=np.logical_or(a,b).sum()
+        score=inter/max(1,union)
+        if score>best[0]: best=(score,dx,dy,(inter,union))
+    return {"iou_local":float(best[0]),"shift_px":[best[1],best[2]],"intersection_union":best[3],
+            "target_px":int(tar.sum()),"pred_px":int(pr.sum())}
+
+def run():
+    s=Session(instance="/app/instance.json", render=False)
+    s.reset()
+    p=s.primitives()
+    s.record_start()
+    paths=[]
+    for si, waypoints in enumerate(STROKES):
+        pts, arc_mm, tang=target_path(waypoints)
+        width_px=measured_width_px(pts,tang)
+        width_mm=width_px*PX_M*1000.0
+        press=press_for_width_mm(width_mm)
+        # Lighten the very first/final few millimetres into soft brush tips.
+        ramp_len=5.5
+        start_gain=np.clip(arc_mm/ramp_len, .18, 1.0)
+        end_gain=np.clip((arc_mm[-1]-arc_mm)/ramp_len, .18, 1.0)
+        press=press*np.minimum(start_gain,end_gain)
+        # The first root's parabolic tail reaches the painted endpoint without spilling behind it.
+        s0=float(np.clip(drag_mm(press[min(np.searchsorted(arc_mm,5),len(press)-1)])+0.5,2.5,9.5))
+        root_s=arc_mm[arc_mm>=s0]
+        if len(root_s)==0 or root_s[0] > s0+0.1: root_s=np.r_[s0,root_s]
+        # Include a clean near-end sample; last pressure tapers naturally to the target tip.
+        if root_s[-1] < arc_mm[-1]: root_s=np.r_[root_s,arc_mm[-1]]
+        root_xy=np.column_stack([np.interp(root_s,arc_mm,pts[:,0]),np.interp(root_s,arc_mm,pts[:,1])])
+        tang_xy=np.column_stack([np.interp(root_s,arc_mm,tang[:,0]),np.interp(root_s,arc_mm,tang[:,1])])
+        norm=np.maximum(1e-9,np.linalg.norm(tang_xy,axis=1)); tang_xy/=norm[:,None]
+        pr=np.interp(root_s,arc_mm,press)
+        world=px_to_world(root_xy)
+        # Convert image tangent to the horizontal world direction (image-down is world -x).
+        wt=np.column_stack([-tang_xy[:,1],-tang_xy[:,0]])
+        # Ink dip, then keep the brush above the sheets while moving to this stroke.
+        p["move_tip"]([-0.100,0.150,0.075], speed=0.05)
+        p["move_tip"]([-0.100,0.150,0.026], speed=0.025, settle=5)
+        if not s.brush_state().get("loaded", s.painter.loaded):
+            raise RuntimeError("dip did not load ink")
+        p["move_tip"]([-0.100,0.150,0.075], speed=0.04)
+        # Prime direction in air, ending over the first intended root.
+        first=world[0]
+        vdir=wt[0]
+        prime=first-0.006*vdir
+        p["move_tip"]([prime[0],prime[1],0.065], speed=0.04)
+        p["move_tip"]([first[0],first[1],0.065], speed=0.012)
+        z0=PAPER_Z-pr[0]/1000.0
+        p["move_tip"]([first[0],first[1],z0], speed=0.012, settle=1)
+        # Lead each root sample by the pressure-dependent brush offset.
+        for xy, tv, pm in zip(world,wt,pr):
+            lead=offset_mm(pm)/1000.0
+            tip=xy+tv*lead
+            p["move_tip"]([tip[0],tip[1],PAPER_Z-pm/1000.0], speed=0.012)
+        # Lift in place to end this inked contact, then go to the next dip.
+        last=world[-1]+wt[-1]*(offset_mm(pr[-1])/1000.0)
+        p["move_tip"]([last[0],last[1],0.060], speed=0.015, settle=2)
+        paths.append({"stroke":si+1,"length_mm":float(arc_mm[-1]),"pressure_range_mm":[float(pr.min()),float(pr.max())],
+                      "width_range_mm":[float(width_mm.min()),float(width_mm.max())],"root_start_mm":s0,
+                      "waypoints":len(pts)})
+        print("stroke",si+1,paths[-1],flush=True)
+
+    actions=s.record_stop()
+    # Final no-op lift was already part of stroke 7; commit a deterministic replay artifact.
+    s.painter.finish()
+    out=OUT/"trajectory.npz"
+    s.save_trajectory(actions,out,meta={"paths":paths,"planner":"target medial axes + Wang brush offset lead"})
+    pred=s.ink()>=0.5
+    Image.fromarray(np.where(pred[:,:,None],np.array([18,17,19],np.uint8),np.array([248,244,236],np.uint8))).save(OUT/"candidate.png")
+    print("actions",actions.shape,"status",s.status(),flush=True)
+    print("local",mask_metrics(pred),flush=True)
+    print("service score",json.dumps(s.score(),sort_keys=True),flush=True)
+    print("saved",out,flush=True)
+
+if __name__=="__main__": run()
*** End Patch";
